description: The AI clients the CALLING person has connected, as one list: hosted-MCP OAuth clients (Claude, ChatGPT, ...) and personal access tokens, each with its `reaches`: all_workspaces, one_workspace, needs_reconnect or this_workspace. An OAuth connection has no access level of its own: it acts as the person, so their workspace role and grants decide what it can do. A personal access token (connected: token) DOES carry a scope, read, write or admin, set when it was created and enforced on every call: a read token is refused a write. Lists only the caller's own connections; read-only (disconnecting is a person's act in Settings). [Full notes: get_started section "TOOL NOTES list_ai_connections"]
name: list_ai_connections
title: List my connected AI clients
